findings.issue: Positive file can contain complete JSON before trailing newline/flush/close raises; written.append(path) occurs only after save_new returns. Failure revocation skips existing-but-not-written path, retaining true role flags on actual EXIT1.
findings.witness: Exclusive open succeeds; json.dump completes; trailing write or __exit__ raises OSError. Outer written stays empty for that path; path.exists is true; neither negative branch condition executes.
findings.minimum_fix: Track actual exclusive-created ownership before positive bytes, then revoke owned attempted files even when write/close fails. Do not overwrite an unrelated preexisting/race-created output.

findings.issue: If negative receipt writes both raise, caught save_error types only enter secondary list in memory. Final negative stdout includes primary error type alone, so secondary types vanish from every surviving result.
findings.witness: Primary failure then PermissionError/OSError on both negative writes; no receipt holds appended secondary_errors, no rethrow prints secondary, final stdout omits them.
findings.minimum_fix: Include bounded phase/type-only secondary errors in final negative stdout alongside preserved primary type; keep no positive qualification.
